stories.title: Who's on the CFP bubble? Did Week 8 burst the Big 12's two-bid dreams?
stories.summary: A conference-by-conference look at who is contending for the playoff, who's close and who's out.

stories.title: Seahawks acquire eight-time Pro Bowl guard Nelson in trade with Colts
stories.summary: The Colts have traded eight-time Pro Bowl guard Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks.

stories.title: Sources: Jazz's Jackson (knee) out 6-8 weeks; Markkanen also hurt
stories.summary: Utah will be down two more of its bigs as Jaren Jackson Jr. has a torn MCL in his right knee and will miss at least six weeks, while Lauri Markkanen is day to day with a sprained wrist.

stories.title: Raptors without Kawhi for weeks due to knee swelling, sources say
stories.summary: Kawhi Leonard is expected to miss a period of weeks due to swelling in his left knee, sources told ESPN's Shams Charania.

stories.title: Miss. State QB Taylor needs surgery, to miss rest of season
stories.summary: Mississippi State QB Kamario Taylor, college football's breakout star this season, needs surgery on his injured toe and will miss the remainder of the season.
